name: Lotto Grand Prix de Wallonie
story: At the start, a breakaway group of six riders formed. Mid-race, they were joined by a peloton group including Abrahamsen and Gualdi. With 20 km to go, all riders regrouped. On the final climb, Romain Grégoire and Paul Lapeira attacked but were overtaken in the last meters by Aubin Sparfel.
